explanation: The English article says that from February 2011, as Gaddafi's Libya collapsed, hundreds of his Tuareg fighters returned to Mali with large stockpiles of weapons. Many of them were veterans of earlier rebellions and out of work. In October 2011 the returning fighters negotiated at Zakak with local leaders and formed the National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad, which began the rebellion of 16 January 2012. The article hangs that sentence on Miroiu and Alecu, so two named authors stand behind it.
